title: Lead-Acid Batteries
description: Specific gravity and charge of lead acid batteries - temperature and efficiency.

components.content: Lead-Acid Battery State of Charge Reference Table

## Voltage and Specific Gravity vs. State of Charge (SOC)

The table above shows the relationship between state of charge and key battery parameters:

- **Overcharged**: Specific gravity above 1.30
- **Very Low Capacity**: Specific gravity ranging 1.13 - 1.15
- **Discharged**: Specific gravity below 1.12

## Battery Efficiency vs. Temperature

Lead-acid battery efficiency varies significantly with temperature. Higher temperatures generally improve performance, while colder temperatures reduce efficiency.

## Specific Gravity vs. Temperature

Specific gravity in a fully charged lead acid battery varies with temperature. Temperature compensation may be necessary for accurate state of charge determination.
